hook: NFL memo called Flores *"an angry Black man"*
dek: Unsealed Raiders memo fuels Brian Flores' discrimination lawsuit against the NFL.

slides.label: What happened
slides.text: A Korn Ferry recruiting memo evaluating *Brian Flores* for an NFL head coach job was unsealed Tuesday.

slides.label: Who's involved
slides.text: The memo was prepared for the *Las Vegas Raiders* during their coaching search.

slides.label: The language
slides.text: It said Flores was 'polished' *"despite growing up in Brownsville, Brooklyn"* and noted a friendship with a billionaire's son.

slides.label: The accusation
slides.text: His attorney said the report painted him as an *"angry Black man"*, calling him unpredictable and able to *"fool you with his polish."*

slides.label: Retaliation claim
slides.text: The memo also flagged his *lawsuit itself* as a weakness, warning 'ongoing litigation may be a distraction.'

slides.label: Bigger picture
slides.text: Flores sued the NFL, Broncos, Giants and Texans in 2022. Ex-coaches *Steve Wilks and Ray Horton* joined him.

slides.label: Where it stands
slides.text: The Raiders declined to comment. The lawsuit over NFL hiring bias is *still ongoing*.

slides.label: Why it matters
slides.text: When 'professional polish' reads as a surprise for a Black man, it shows bias can hide in plain sight in hiring rooms everywhere.

question: Does this memo prove bias? Yes or no.
first_comment: The memo literally flagged Flores' own discrimination lawsuit as a 'weakness' in his candidacy. Let that sink in.

caption_instagram:
NFL coaching bias is back in the headlines after a Korn Ferry memo evaluating Brian Flores for the Las Vegas Raiders head coaching job got unsealed, and his attorneys say it's loaded with racial stereotypes.

The report called Flores 'polished' despite growing up in Brownsville, Brooklyn, and credited a friendship with a billionaire's son for teaching him to relate to upper class people. His attorney straight up called it painting Flores as an 'angry Black man.' The memo even flagged his own discrimination lawsuit as a professional weakness.

Flores sued the NFL and three teams back in 2022, and former coaches Steve Wilks and Ray Horton later joined him. The Raiders declined to comment. The case is still active.

Does this memo prove bias? Yes or no.
